data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to monitor real network connectivity across mobile, web, and desktop.
data.what_it_does: Provides streams and one‑time checks for real network connectivity. It also offers a widget builder for UI updates.
use_when: Need real network status across iOS, Android, Web, Windows, Linux, macOS
Want a single plugin for all platforms
avoid_when: Need Wi‑Fi SSID or BSSID info (removed APIs)
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec, import package, no special permissions needed
